description: Add integrated/e2e coverage for lazy ingress through hydration, materialization, AI projection, trace persistence and BO retrieval; update service docs; run mix format and mix q.

comments.text: Validation complete in working tree: focused attachment/security/integration suites pass; mix format and mix q pass; upstream jido_ai mix precommit passes. Full ZAQ suite: 48 doctests, 40 properties, 7765 tests, 6 unrelated failures (skill description truncation x3, file preview fallback x2, MCP timeout UI x1). Full jido_ai suite reproduced one existing RunStrategyTest timing failure, which passed focused rerun. git diff --check passes in both repos. Left issue open because changes are intentionally uncommitted and full suites are not entirely green.

Reworked media projection per review: core Jido.Plugin now defines transform_tool_result/3 post-tool interception; jido_ai runs mounted plugins in declaration order, preserves canonical tool_completed results, and uses transformed content in both Runner and durable Strategy context. Removed all ReAct tool_result_transformer config/request/action/fingerprint/event plumbing. ZAQ Factory now registers MediaResultTransformer only as a plugin; StreamEvents handles canonical tool_completed only. Validation: core Jido mix q + 2211 tests pass; jido_ai mix precommit passes and focused 235 tests pass (full suite had one unrelated timing failure that passed direct rerun); ZAQ mix q + focused 61 tests pass. git diff --check passes in all three repos. No commits made.

Updated media refactor for handle-based communication materialization: JidoChat records now carry signed communication_media materialization_handle values; the existing Channels :materialize_record event routes by provider after handle verification; obsolete RecordCapability/RecordHydrator/hydrate_record/materializing_event code and tests were removed. Factory.after_tool_call now composes materialization aliases with MediaResultTransformer using ReqLLM.ToolResult for model-facing content parts, and StreamEvents extracts trace artifacts from ToolResult.output. Validation: focused media/materialization suite passed (6 doctests, 3 properties, 579 tests, 0 failures); mix q passed; git diff --check passed.
